newsitem.title: GHANA: Accra bourse rises, led by Aluworks.
newsitem.headline: Accra bourse rises, led by Aluworks.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange All-Share index rose on Wednesday, with Aluworks rising 100 cedis to 1,200 cedis after a losing run, the exchange's market report showed.
The index rose 1.35 points to 366.49, after rising 2.26 points on Monday.
A total of 120,210 shares changed hands with bids outstripping offers by 7,342,910 to 513,910.
Mechanical Lloyd Company rose eight to 70, Social Security Bank six to 1,260 and consumer products company Unilever three to 838.
Pioneer Aluminium Factory, down five to 160 and Home Finance Company, down one at 140 were the two declining issues.
